messages:
Jordan: Heads-up — compliance asked if we can add a streaming export for audit events (who changed what/when) from the Console. They want gzipped NDJSON over a webhook or direct S3 ship, with filters by org/project/model/route.
Priya: +1 from product. Important for SOC2 customers. UX question: do we expose 'live stream' toggle vs scheduled exports in the Console? :thinking_face:
Alex: Technical note — streaming is doable but we need backpressure & retry semantics. Webhook + ack model preferred. We already have export jobs for batch CSV/NDJSON.
Casey: Routing policy concern: if customers have dedicated + hosted combined, exports should reflect source (hosted vs dedicated) and not leak internal routing details. Need `source` field on events.
Nina: Security checklist: must support tenant-scoped KMS for S3 destinations, and field redaction (PII) rules. Also retention & delete-on-request flows.
Sam: Legal: customers may need proof-of-export chain-of-custody. Add export audit entries (who configured export, when it ran, success/failure). Also TTL for exports we store in our system.
Jordan: Example minimal event we expect: `{timestamp, actor, action, target, route, source, request_id}`. We should version the schema.
Alex: Implementation sketch:
```
POST /api/v1/audit/exports
body: {type: "stream" | "batch", dest: {webhook|s3}, filters: {...}, encrypt: true}
```
We'd spin up a lightweight streamer per export config that subscribes to our internal event bus.
Priya: Console UX — want a single 'Audit exports' page with a Create flow: choose filters, preview sample events, choose dest, set retention, and a quota estimate. Quotas matter — streaming could be heavy.
Casey: Quotas & pricing: we need to enforce per-tenant export throughput and rate-limit webhooks. Add backpressure metrics to Console dashboard so customers can see dropped/missed events.
Nina: Redaction: allow customer-managed regex rules + standard PII scrubbers. Also need an option to mask actor identity for endpoints that require pseudonymization.
Sam: Also add an approvals step for exports to external endpoints (for enterprise + legal review). Audit the approval decision.
infra-bot: export-job-creator: created export job 4321 for org:acme -> s3://redwood-exports/acme/4321.gz (status: pending)
Alex: For incremental/batch hybrid: support checkpointing token so restarts don't duplicate events. Use at-least-once delivery semantics and idempotency keys on export events.
Jordan: UX + API parity: If Console exposes sampling/filters, the internal API should accept the same DSL. Avoid making Console-only features.
Priya: Priya: Can we add a sandbox toggle that streams to a customer-visible preview UI (no external dest) so they can validate filters before going live?
Casey: Yes, preview mode would be low-rate and only available to admins. Implementation: sample 1% or up to N events until stopped.
Nina: For compliance, attach signed manifests for each batch export: hash of file + signed timestamp.
Sam: Good. Also capture the operator who changed the export config and export it as part of the manifest.
Alex: Open engineering questions: where to run the streamer? control plane vs data plane. Running in control plane simplifies auth but may not have access to dedicated infra logs.
Jordan: Action items I can own: write a short proposal (scope + security requirements + API contract) by EOD Friday. Priya — can you draft the Console flow/wireframe? Nina + Sam — add security & legal checklists.
Priya: I'll mock the flow and add a preview sample in Figma by Tuesday.
Nina: I'll enumerate redaction options and KMS flows, send to the thread.
Sam: I'll write the approval policy template and retained fields list.
Casey: I'll run a quick estimate for throughput + quota model, and propose rate limits.
Alex: I'll prototype a streamer that consumes from the audit topic and pushes to a webhook with ack/retry. Expect PR in 2 weeks.
Jordan: Thanks all — ping me if you need infra creds. :tada:
